title: AI
description: Is the AI working, good and inside its quota? Errors and quota, draft quality (people and judges), the orchestrator, response time, providers, safety.

panels.title: AI requests failed
panels.description: Share of /complete requests to the gateway that did not get an answer, last hour (after any fallback).

panels.title: Drafts kept (7 days)
panels.description: Share of AI drafts people published, as written or edited, rather than discarded.

panels.title: Answer relevance (7 days)
panels.description: LangSmith judge: share of drafts that address the actual question.

panels.title: Judges that worked (24 h)
panels.description: Share of judge runs that produced a score (the rest failed: rate limits, bad output).

targets.expr: sum(associator_evals_feedback{judge!="human_decision", stat="scored", window="24h"}) / (sum(associator_evals_feedback{judge!="human_decision", stat="scored", window="24h"}) + sum(associator_evals_feedback{judge!="human_decision", stat="errors", window="24h"}))

panels.title: Platform AI cap used
panels.description: Share of today's 300 Platform AI answers (the platform's own daily cap) already used.

panels.title: AI cost, last 24 h
panels.description: Model cost in US dollars (Platform AI and people's own models).

panels.title: Rate-limited share of AI requests
panels.description: Share of gateway requests answered 429 (quota used up) after any fallback. Dashed line: the 20% alert.

panels.title: Model calls by result
panels.description: Every model call the gateway tried, by model and cause (quota_exhausted, upstream_busy, timeout...).

panels.title: Platform quota left
panels.description: Groq free plan per model: requests left today (of 1,000) and tokens left this minute (of 8,000).

panels.title: Fallbacks per hour
panels.description: Platform AI calls answered by the backup model because the main one was rate limited.

panels.title: Drafts kept, by path (7 days)
panels.description: direct: one model; single: orchestrator, one model; split: orchestrator, several models merged.

panels.title: Draft decisions per hour
panels.description: What people did with AI drafts, by mode.

panels.title: Judge averages (7 days)
panels.description: Yes/no judges as a share (relevance, code, tone: higher is better; toxicity, bias, PII, invented: lower is better). Conciseness is 0-10.

panels.title: Judge failures (24 h)
panels.description: Judge runs that failed, per judge. Judges are spread over three Groq models so they do not share one budget.

panels.title: Judge success rate over time
panels.description: Scored / (scored + failed), all judges, last 24 h (rolling).

targets.expr: sum(associator_evals_feedback{judge!="human_decision", stat="scored", window="24h"}) / (sum(associator_evals_feedback{judge!="human_decision", stat="scored", window="24h"}) + sum(associator_evals_feedback{judge!="human_decision", stat="errors", window="24h"}))

panels.title: Answer relevance over time
panels.description: LangSmith judge, last 24 h and 7 days (rolling).

panels.title: Runs per hour
panels.description: By path (single: one model; split: planned parts on several models, merged) and result.

panels.title: Time per step (p95)
panels.description: plan (Platform AI), work (each part), merge, shorten, single, and the whole run.

panels.title: Why runs failed (7 days)
panels.description: all_models_failed, too_long, empty_answer...

panels.title: Model tries (7 days)
panels.description: Calls to people's own models and Platform AI, by result (a failed try falls back to the next model).

panels.title: Parts planned (7 days)
panels.description: What the planner split questions into.

panels.title: Runs with fallback, memory (7 days)
panels.description: How often a run needed another model, and how often memory was on.

panels.title: AI response time for people (p95)
panels.description: Platform AI and people's own models: one model call. Excludes internal tools. Target: under 3 s.

panels.title: Model response time by model (p95)
panels.description: Every model the gateway calls, internal tools included.

panels.title: Provider response time (p95)
panels.description: How long providers take to answer.

panels.title: Tokens per hour by model
panels.description: Input and output tokens (api's direct calls).

panels.title: Safety findings, 24 h
panels.description: What the safety checks found in content people tried to publish: blocked, asked to confirm, or warned.

panels.title: Safety check time (p95)
panels.description: How long a safety check takes.
